note: HDB layout archetypes distilled from the customer-uploaded plan corpus (uploads/plan-*, 85 files, Jul 2026). Keyed by archetype NAME, never by upload filename, so one mislabelled file cannot poison the matcher. envelopes_m lists printed overall dimensions actually observed in the corpus (metres, w x d, either orientation matches). hallmarks are room names that distinguish the archetype; anti are rooms that rule it out. code_prefix documents the observed HDB numerical-code convention: first digit = flat type room count (34211001 = 3-room, 45211229 = 4-room, 53311617 = 5-room, 2000xxxx = 2-room).
